implementationNotes: Default defuse: first 13 regulation wins, sides after 12 rounds.
User-selected tie policy: repeat MR3 at 12-12, switch after every 3 overtime rounds. Local Premier config has overtime_limit 1; unlimited repeats are a project choice.
Team deathmatch first 100 enemy kills is the requested room rule, not claimed as the official CS2 deathmatch ruleset.

Primary, secondary and combined controls follow Valve grenade semantics; velocity scales full=1,lob=.65,drop=.3, 200ms pin preparation and trajectories are bounded browser approximations. Fuse begins after release, not while pin is held.
Bot angular damping/reaction/hysteresis is independent implementation. Dropped guns are bounded 64/120s and cleared each round.
